meta.title: Custom end-time duration in Minutes, Hours or Days
gaps: Verify the calculated end time equals the start time plus the entered numeric value in the selected Minutes, Hours, or Days unit.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the calculated end time equals the start time plus the entered numeric value in the selected Minutes, Hours, or Days unit.

steps.note: Open a create screen where the event schedule can be configured.
Provide the required event title so the schedule flow can be completed.
Apply a template so line items and the schedule controls become available.
Add the required line item for a valid event setup.
Complete the pricing sheet before configuring the schedule.
Choose the custom end-time duration option.
Enter a numeric custom duration; the catalog does not confirm this field's exact label.
Choose the duration unit; the catalog does not confirm this selector's exact label.
Confirm that the schedule panel displays an end-time calculation after saving.
